formal_object.rationale: Verified dimensions and row-vector convention: per-module C is d by d, U orthogonal, T=U diag(Bb) U.T. The objective is fit-reference CE with empirical native-to-steered KL; it does not optimize benchmark correctness directly.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: Checked scaling invariance counterexample and eigenspace rotation invariance. Repeated-eigenvalue tying is required for basis-invariant T; near ties are explicitly a numerical approximation. Conditional compactness argument requires finite continuous model outputs and positive bounded gains.

derivation.rationale: Checked local chain-rule derivative and grouped-coordinate gradient B.T grad_a. Projected steps occur in b coordinates, not an incorrectly clipped Fisher solution. Generation folding W_new=T.T W and bias_new=T.T bias matches row activations only in exact arithmetic, so actual BF16 checks are required.

assumptions.rationale: Checked fit/guard separation, fit-only covariance, native training-prefix probe, raw-logit full-vocabulary KL, exact generated IDs and no false EOS. Guard is a one-final-candidate veto reused across rounds, not an independent test. Model/basis freeze and state restoration are mandatory.

method_expression.rationale: Finite projected line search with measured fit decrease and KL acceptance is a coherent approximate solver. Identity is feasible and must be an exact bypass. The method does not assert convergence, full-distribution KL bounds, correct-step weights or learned SFT loss.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Controller feasibility and restoration are software-falsifiable. Actual recursive score/coverage at extra compute is a separate hypothesis; fit-loss improvement alone cannot qualify scientific success. Same-40-reference comparator is required to isolate the gain rule.

closest_alternative.rationale: Reviewed existing b8 pipeline/calibration/spectral source and prior primary ASC/STS/Ren sources in the root thread. Known coefficient fitting and KL constraints are attributed; selection is scoped implementation of one user-chosen adaptation, not an originality or exhaustive-search finding.
